intro: So you're the one lighting up the archipelago again. Mind the stairs, there are two hundred.
Glass, wax, oil and charts. Merge two of a kind and the sailors will pay you for them.
Marisol says you saw the café burn from up here.
I saw a boat with no lights. Fix my workshop and I'll show you my logbook.

tasks.title: Clear the workshop door
dialogue: Salt has eaten the hinges. Everything up here is rust and fog.
That's Wick. He keeps the moths away and judges my cooking.

tasks.title: Fire up the glass kiln
dialogue: Bram, glassblower. Well, apprentice. The kiln's been cold for years.
Since the night the lamp went out.
The lamp went out? The same night as the fire?

tasks.title: Build a work bench
dialogue: With a bench I can cut lenses again. Proper ones.
The old lens cracked. Somebody climbed up here and broke it.

tasks.title: Find the keeper's logbook
dialogue: Here. Last entry before the dark: 'Boat, no lights, rowing from the café pier. One man. Cigar smoke.'
Cigar smoke... the lighter Kai found had the initials R.H.
I wrote it down. Nobody ever asked to read it.

tasks.title: Repair the spiral stairs
dialogue: He likes the new steps. Less flying.
Now visitors can reach the lamp room. Business, at last.

tasks.title: Relight the great lamp
dialogue: Look at that. Every boat between here and Verdant can see it.
We saw it from the Reef Grill! The whole crew cheered.

tasks.title: Open the lantern shop
dialogue: Sailors want lanterns, candles, charts. We'll sell them all.
And we'll ask every one of them what they remember.

tasks.title: Restore the chart room
dialogue: Your grandfather drew half of these charts. Look, the harbour spring is marked in red.
He marked it on every map. Like he wanted nobody to forget it.

tasks.title: Fix the fog horn
dialogue: I heard that horn from my boat! Thought it was a ghost.
Tobias. You were out that night too.
I was. I saw the mayor's skiff tied at the café pier. I never said. I was afraid.

tasks.title: Cut a new lens
dialogue: My first full lens. It's not perfect.
It's perfect enough. Light doesn't need perfect, it needs someone to keep it.

tasks.title: Build a lamp gallery
dialogue: I dove for the old lens pieces. One still has a fingerprint in the soot.
The deed, the lighter, the logbook, the skiff... and now this.
Evidence enough for the island council.

tasks.title: Hold the Night of Lights
dialogue: Every lantern on every island, lit at once. For your grandfather.
Next, the Stone Steps. The council meets at the Terrace Tea House.
